programs.title: Restored
programs.desc: Homeowners Steven and Gina call in preservationist Brett Waterman to restore their recent purchase, a French Normandy-style cottage, which was neglected for 30 years; Brett tackles the home's leaky roof, rotten windows and missing floorboards.

programs.title: Restored
programs.desc: A couple seeks Brett's help restoring their 1900 Victorian farmhouse in time for their wedding; they're hoping Brett can design a rustic kitchen, update the laundry area and add light to the interior rooms that were closed off by past modifications.

programs.desc: Gray and Grumpy help a family transform their 1890s home from a duplex back into its original design as a single-family home; Gray adds her signature boldness and whimsy, making it a standout in Charleston's historic district.

programs.title: Restoring Galveston
programs.desc: The Cordrays help a couple restore a home in Galveston's historic east end that once belonged to Michael's grandmother; in addition to bringing much-needed structural support, they find vintage touches for their living room, kitchen and pantry.
